blocks.text: East Central homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

East Central, September 2026. Detached houses: 82 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 120 listed at month end and 11 sold in September, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 36 sold over 4 months against an average of 75.8 listed, about 8.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 17 sold. Condos and townhomes: 68 sold over 4 months against an average of 113.2 listed, about 6.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 22 sold.

faq.q: Which schools are in East Central?
faq.a: Golden Ears Elementary and Harry Hooge Elementary (K–7), Thomas Haney Secondary (7–12), ci:tməxw Environmental Community (K–8) and District 42 Alternative Secondary are physically in the area; catchments are address-specific — for the downtown sample address used in the research (11897 227 Street), the SD42 locator gives Eric Langton Elementary and Thomas Haney Secondary.

faq.q: How do I get downtown or to the SkyTrain?
faq.a: Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) runs West Coast Express trains to Waterfront Station on weekdays, and the R3 RapidBus runs from Haney Place Exchange to Coquitlam Central Station.

faq.q: Is flood risk a factor in East Central?
faq.a: Along the Fraser River at the south edge (River Road / Port Haney), yes: the flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic, no habitable floor space may sit below it on affected lots, and floodplain status is registered by covenant on title.

faq.q: What changed in the Town Centre plan?
faq.a: The Town Centre Area Plan update expanded the plan boundaries to include River Bend, consolidated the land use designations, and added a Town Centre Core designation for higher densities around the Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station.
